# [The Future of BIM Planning: Plannerly's Biggest Release Yet](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yxZvUm3AJWo)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [Plannerly - The BIM Management Platform](https://www.youtube.com/@plannerlyAEC)
**Uploaded at**: 2026-08-28
**Published at**: 
**Length**: 56:24
**Views**: 1046
**Likes**: 20
**Category**: Howto & Style

## Description

```
The biggest update in Plannerly's history, walked through live on one real project - client requirements in, verified and certified delivery out. One 10-step workflow, more than 50 further improvements, Plannerly on mobile, and four things coming this October.

Everything shown is already live in your account - nothing to install, nothing extra to pay.

📎 The slides: https://plannerly.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/plannerly-biggest-update-yet-webinar-slides.pdf 
🎓 Free training + the new ISO 19650 Master Practitioner course: https://plannerly.com/training/
💬 Prefer a conversation? Book 20 minutes: https://plannerly.com/meeting 

Chapters:
0:00 Welcome - the biggest Plannerly update yet
1:30 Simple by Design - settings panel, flexible toolbar, pop-out panels
2:20 AI Docs + Scope Import - EIR in, structured project out
3:45 Advanced Work Packages
5:05 Comments That Resolve
6:45 Scheduling & Timeline - with resource histograms
7:50 Multi-Model Verify - federated checking
9:20 Automated Payment Certification
11:05 Project Chat
13:15 The New Notification Engine
14:55 Activity Audit Trail
16:20 The live demo begins - Simple by Design
17:55 Live: AI Scope Import - drop in Word + Excel, watch it build the project
24:00 Live: Advanced Work Packages
25:55 Live: Comments That Resolve + live dashboards
29:40 Live: Scheduling & Timeline
32:05 Live: Multi-Model Verify - federated models from Autodesk Forma
37:05 Live: Payment Certification - map status to money
40:05 Live: Project Chat
41:15 Live: The Notification Engine
41:50 Live: Activity Audit Trail
42:40 More than 50 more improvements - ten quick highlights
45:25 Plannerly on mobile - it's here
46:55 The complete API - read and write
47:30 Where should we go deeper? Your votes
49:25 Four more things coming this October
50:05 Meet Javis - your personal assistant
51:20 MCP - plug in your own AI
52:00 CDE integrations + the new export engine
53:40 The Ideas Board - the next release starts here
54:45 The prize wheel
55:30 Ask us anything + the training courses

Which feature should we go deeper on first? Tell us in the comments - the answers genuinely decide our next sessions.
```
